text: New full-window SCTM workbook: one row per baseline control, columns walking implementation, requirements, allocations, evidence, status, results, issues, POA&M items and risks.
Seven sheets as tabs (SCTM, Controls, Requirements, Evidence, Findings, Risks, Analysis); each sheet's footer says plainly what its rows read.
Spreadsheet behaviour: name box, formula bar, cell, range, row and column selection, keys, resize, frozen header and first column, sort, filter, find.
Right-click (or long-press) a cell, row or column header for its menu: open the row's control preview or page, sort, filter, fit, copy.
Every record in a cell is a link that opens its existing preview beside the grid; on a phone the preview rises as a sheet.
Paste tab-separated values into editable cells, freeze up to any of the first five columns, and find the keyboard shortcuts under More.
Implementation, narrative and requirement title or statement edit in place, stay staged and undoable, then Review changes applies them to WS-X90's records.
Analysis sheet: coverage by family and chain gaps as live IronCalc formulas over the other sheets; they follow staged edits; type your own.
Colour only for status words, the staged-change marks and save state; links blue; evidence Accepted prints plain so colour marks what needs action.
A requirement outside the register's sample now opens its own preview, drawn from the snapshot, instead of the first row's.
Narratives and statuses applied in the SCTM workbook show in the SSP editor and its session list.
A More menu in the header opens the SCTM workbook; an applied title edit shows in the register's rows and the requirement preview.
The header's More menu gains Open the SCTM workbook.
